ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Microsoft Office Child Process - MacOS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes spawning from microsoft office suite applications such as word or excel. This could indicates malicious macro execution

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\ Word.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\ Excel.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\ PowerPoint.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*Microsoft\\ OneNote.*")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\/bash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/curl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/dash$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/fish$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/osacompile$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/osascript$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/sh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/zsh$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/python$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/python3$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/wget$")))
